rules: A verified identity is not organization authority.
Only a current ACTIVE membership row grants tenant membership.
Browser headers, request bodies, JWT role, app_metadata, and user_metadata are selection hints or identity attributes only and never membership authority.
Organization and permission checks fail closed when identity, membership, role assignment, or transaction-local database context is absent or stale.

session.csrf: state-changing cookie-authenticated BFF requests require same-origin CSRF protection
session.membershipFreshness: resolve current membership for every domain request; any cache must be bounded and invalidated by membership version
session.membershipRemovalEffect: deny the next domain request after authoritative membership removal
session.revocation: sign-out or account closure revokes refresh sessions; sensitive operations may require current session_id validation
session.logging: log only safe actor, session correlation, organization, membership, action, result, and trace identifiers; never tokens, cookies, metadata payloads, or profile values

rules.condition: identity is absent, invalid, expired, anonymous, or wrong issuer/audience
selection is supplied and no current ACTIVE membership exists for subject plus organization
selection is supplied and exactly one current ACTIVE membership matches subject plus organization
selection is absent and exactly one current ACTIVE membership exists
selection is absent and multiple current ACTIVE memberships exist
selection is absent and no current ACTIVE membership exists

tenantResolution.antiEnumeration: A selected organization without an active membership returns the same permission-denied envelope whether the organization exists or not.
tenantResolution.requestContext: immutable request-scoped value derived after authentication and membership lookup; never a process singleton
tenantResolution.resourceRule: A resource organizationId must equal resolved organizationId before permission evaluation and persistence access.

membership.cardinality: at most one membership per organizationId plus subjectId
membership.roleCardinality: exactly one tenant role for every ACTIVE membership in v1
membership.versioning: all membership and role mutations require expectedVersion and increment version
membership.ownerInvariant: every non-deleting organization has at least one ACTIVE OWNER; the last owner cannot leave, be removed, suspended, or demoted until another owner is active
membership.assignmentRule: the actor requires both user.manage and role.manage, must hold every permission granted by the target role, and only an OWNER may assign OWNER

platform.rule: No implicit tenant access or RLS bypass. Any future break-glass tenant access requires a separate audited R3 contract.

roles.migration: owner-capable migration identity; never used by application runtime
roles.runtime: non-owner login role with no BYPASSRLS; only minimum application-schema privileges
roles.supabaseApiRoles: anon, authenticated, and service_role receive no domain relation privileges in v1

rls.membershipPredicate: transaction-local subject and membership identify a current ACTIVE membership for the same organization
rls.writeCheck: INSERT and UPDATE WITH CHECK enforce the resolved organization; UPDATE also requires a matching SELECT/USING policy
rls.views: security_invoker only or unavailable to runtime/API roles
rls.functions: security invoker by default; any exceptional definer function is private, fixed-search-path, least-grant, and separately reviewed

sequence: set all three settings locally from the resolved request context
verify pooled connection has no retained settings

api.profileRule: profile values are user-editable domain data and never authorization inputs

M2-DB01: implement the declared relations, constraints, grants, forced RLS, transaction settings, database fixtures, and rollback evidence
prove runtime-role and pooled-connection isolation without changing this vocabulary
M2-T01: validate JWT identity and session claims, implement access/profile/tenant APIs, and resolve membership on every domain request
deny removed, suspended, anonymous, forged-selection, and cross-tenant cases
M2-T02: implement the centralized deny-by-default evaluator and role-assignment invariants from this exact matrix
do not hardcode endpoint behavior from role names
M2-U01: consume only the generated same-origin API types for access context, explicit organization selection, and allowlisted profile fields
render selection-required, membership-denied, session-expired, conflict, and empty states without treating UI state as authority

limitations: This artifact defines contracts only; it contains no migration, runtime enforcement, UI, hosted configuration, provider call, or live Supabase evidence.
Custom tenant roles, platform break-glass access, tenant deletion, provider administration, and Data API domain access require later accepted contracts.
Deterministic fixture tests prove contract consistency only, not PostgreSQL RLS, session revocation, pooled connection cleanup, or hosted behavior.
